title: Business Analyst (Data)
description:
A job opportunity has arisen for an experienced Business Analyst to join a highly established and growing organisation during a period of rapid technical and business transformation.

The Business Analyst will join a newly formed Data function, taking responsibility for process mapping, requirements elicitation and documentation, whilst liaising with several key stakeholders across the organisation. You will support the continuous improvement of processes throughout the business, own the creation of business analysis documentation and support the production of other change related documentation.

The successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:

  • Experience of having worked as a Business Analyst in a Data environment/worked as a Business Analyst on Data projects
  • A proven track record of having worked as a Business Analyst in highly regulated environments
  • ISEB Business Analysis qualification or similar certification
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

This position offers excellent scope for career progression plus a benefits package that includes 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, an excellent pension scheme, life assurance, flexible benefits package and more. This is a hybrid role based in South Wales.

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.
